text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Harare city council has granted the developers of the high-class Borrowdale Brook Estate suburban project permission to go ahead with the project after they agreed to conditions set by the council that 60 percent of the owners of the properties should be black Zimbabweans.

- The harmonisation of Zimbabwe's labour laws to include civil servants in collective wage bargaining has moved a step closer to fruition with the matter now before the Cabinet Committee on Legislation.
- Over 54,300 cases of malaria and 101 deaths have been reported in Zimbabwe's Mashonaland Central this year.
